content:
Nina L. (PM): FYI tested the console on a foldable+phone combo today. noticed table overflow + cramped sidebar when in narrow-landscape. attaching notes. :mag:
Ravi (Design): saw similar during user research — users expect actions to be reachable without precise taps when the device bends. suggestion: convert rows -> stacked list at narrow widths and promote the primary action to a persistent footer action on small landscape.
Tess A. (Frontend): can you clarify breakpoint? narrow landscape is what numbers?
Eli (QA): repro: simulate Pixel Fold in landscape emulator. viewport reported 540px wide but safe area inset removes ~32px on each side depending on hinge. effective space ~476-488px.
Ravi (Design): propose two tiers: - <=600px: stacked card rows, actions collapse under an "Actions" disclosure per row - 600-760px: compact table with truncated columns + sticky action column - fallback: overflow-x:auto if nothing else works
Tess A. (Frontend): implementation options: 1) CSS-only stacked switch with aria attributes + small JS to move actions into a disclosure, 2) full JS layout reflow (heavier). I prefer (1). Example pattern:
```
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .resources-table { display:block; }
  .resource-row { border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; }
  .resource-meta { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; }
}
.row-actions { --tap-size:44px; min-height:var(--tap-size); }
```
Ravi (Design): also recommend using visually persistent labels for each field in stacked mode (e.g. "Model: GPT-3.5") and not only relying on sr-only text.
Eli (QA): accessibility checks: - VoiceOver/TalkBack reads each label+value in the stacked layout - focus order: row -> primary action -> disclosure -> next row - touch area >=44px for any action element
Nina L. (PM): product constraints: we must not hide critical status chips when stacked. status needs to remain prominent (color + text). Also add a feature flag so we can enable on mobile beta users only.
Tess A. (Frontend): small technical note: sticky action column with overflow is tricky on foldables because the seam triggers scroll jank. I'd avoid sticky in the under-600px mode.
Ravi (Design): copy tweak: instead of "More", use "Actions" as the disclosure label. and inside the menu list primary items first: "Open", "Logs", "Restart".
Eli (QA): I'll add automated rotate tests that assert no element drops under safe-area inset and will measure hit-targets using the emulator tool. Ticket RF-4802.
Nina L. (PM): decision: go with CSS-first stacked rows at <=600px, move actions into a labeled disclosure "Actions", keep horizontal scroll only as last-resort fallback, and gate behind feature flag. Tess, estimate?
Tess A. (Frontend): ~3 dev-days (includes small helper to migrate actions into disclosure), +1 QA day. I'll add unit tests for DOM moves and aria attrs.
Ravi (Design): dropping updated mocks: https://assets.redwood.internal/designs/foldable-stacked-v1.png ; also added a11y notes in Figma.
ux-bot: design file uploaded: https://assets.redwood.internal/designs/foldable-stacked-v1.png
Nina L. (PM): next steps: Tess to PR with flag, Ravi to handoff components + CSS tokens, Eli to prepare test matrix. We'll review in sprint planning. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
